milestones.name: Repair the Nexus
milestones.note: Trophy: Progress. Unlocks early progression.

milestones.name: First Kill - Defeat Egis
milestones.note: Trophy: First Kill. Unlocks further progression into The Vessel.

milestones.name: Unlock Hairpin Grapple
milestones.note: Around 3 hours in; essential for navigation.

milestones.name: Unlock map function
milestones.note: Unlocked through story progression.

milestones.name: Unlock gliding ability
milestones.note: Around 8 hours in; expands exploration options.

milestones.name: Unlock arachnid locomotion
milestones.note: Wall and ceiling navigation.

milestones.name: Unlock dash/deflect ability
milestones.note: Improved combat.

milestones.name: Defeat Calderon
milestones.note: Obtain Old-Fashioned Key.

milestones.name: Defeat Sol & Vin
milestones.note: Then collect Lura's Seal.

milestones.name: Defeat FLORA
milestones.note: Then collect Aviaries Passepartout.

milestones.name: Aerial Maneuver - Sawlong Chase
milestones.note: Trophy: Aerial Maneuver. Encounter Sawlong during chase sequence.

milestones.name: Attune The Blood (Liho's Voice)
milestones.note: Trophy: The Blood. Left of Metropolis area.

milestones.name: Attune The Eye (Asma's Voice)
milestones.note: Trophy: The Eye. Above Nexus area.

milestones.name: Attune The Hand (Halyn's Voice)
milestones.note: Trophy: The Hand. In Vaults area.

milestones.name: Attune The Breath (Amytis's Voice)
milestones.note: Trophy: The Breath. In Haven area.

milestones.name: Standard Ending - Now We Can Go On
milestones.note: Trophy: Now We Can Go On. Complete main story, gather all Voices from the Pearls.

milestones.name: Find Severed Fingertip
milestones.note: In the pit beneath the Vaults, far east. Required for True Ending path.

milestones.name: Repair broken hand at The Wheel
milestones.note: Take Severed Fingertip to The Wheel in the Lab, above where you fight The Hand.

milestones.name: Solve The Wheel puzzle
milestones.note: Sequence: 0 → 120 → 240. Reaches The Crucible.

milestones.name: Unlock Flowing Steps
milestones.note: Complete two Crucible platforming challenges.

milestones.name: Reach The Library
milestones.note: Use Flowing Steps to climb gloom waterfall via Canopy/Bell Tower. Elevator third level triggers Boss Shii.

milestones.name: Defeat Boss Shii
milestones.note: Trophy: Welcome Home. Unlocks True Ending.

milestones.name: Unlock Manufactory
milestones.note: Find all 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers.

zones.name: Nexus
zones.fingerprintHint: Starting area; MIO wakes here; Mel's shop present; The Eye attuned above here.

zones.name: The Vessel
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible after repairing Nexus and defeating Egis.

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: The Blood (Liho's Voice) found to the left of this area.

zones.name: Vaults
zones.fingerprintHint: The Hand (Halyn's Voice) attuned here; Severed Fingertip found in pit beneath Vaults.

zones.name: The Lab
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains The Wheel puzzle; above where The Hand is fought; used to repair broken hand with Severed Fingertip.

zones.name: The Crucible
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached by solving The Wheel puzzle (0→120→240); contains two platforming challenges granting Flowing Steps.

zones.name: Bell Tower
zones.fingerprintHint: Part of route from Crucible to Canopy and The Library via gloom waterfall.

zones.name: Canopy
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area; part of True Ending route to The Library via Bell Tower.

zones.name: The Library
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached using Flowing Steps to climb gloom waterfall; elevator third level triggers Boss Shii.

zones.name: Manufactory
zones.fingerprintHint: Unlocked by finding all 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers.
